-- probe/go.mod --
module example.com/lockreceiver

go 1.27
-- probe/direct/direct.go --
package direct

import "logos/sync"

type Box struct { N int }
func (b *Box) Increment() { b.N++ }

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[Box]
	lock.WithLock(func(b *Box) {
		go b.Increment()
	})
}
-- probe/paren/paren.go --
package paren

import "logos/sync"

type Box struct { N int }
func (b *Box) Increment() { b.N++ }

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[Box]
	lock.WithLock(func(b *Box) {
		go (b).Increment()
	})
}
-- probe/expression/expression.go --
package expression

import "logos/sync"

type Box struct { N int }
func (b *Box) Increment() { b.N++ }

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[Box]
	lock.WithLock(func(b *Box) {
		go (*Box).Increment(b)
	})
}
-- probe/synchronous/synchronous.go --
package synchronous

import "logos/sync"

type Box struct { N int }
func (b *Box) Increment() { b.N++ }

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[Box]
	lock.WithLock(func(b *Box) {
		b.Increment()
	})
}
